name: Exp_QQECloud
summary: This EA trades based on the QQECloud indicator, which uses a smoothed RSI with variable smoothing methods to generate trend signals. It opens buy positions when the upper cloud line is above the lower cloud line and sell positions when the reverse is true, with time-restricted entry and exit windows. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes and includes configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于QQECloud指标进行交易，该指标使用平滑RSI配合多种平滑方法生成趋势信号。当上轨云线高于下轨云线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并设有时段限制的入场和出场窗口。仓位管理支持多种保证金模式，并包含可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是QQECloud指标，它基于RSI周期计算上轨和下轨两条云线，通过多周期平滑（支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等9种方法）生成信号。入场条件为：当上轨线高于下轨线时产生买入信号，当上轨线低于下轨线时产生卖出信号，仅在用户指定的小时和分钟（StartHour:StartMinute）才实际开仓。出场条件包括：反向指标信号触发平仓、时间窗口结束（StopHour:StopMinute）强制平仓、以及止损止盈触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易份额，支持自由保证金、余额、亏损份额、固定手数等多种模式。资金管理还包含最大价格偏差（Deviation）控制滑点，以及通过BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose四个布尔开关精细控制多空开平仓权限。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is the QQECloud indicator, which calculates upper and lower cloud lines based on an RSI period, smoothed using one of nine available methods (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, SMMA). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the upper cloud line exceeds the lower cloud line, and a sell signal when the upper line falls below the lower line; however, actual trade execution is restricted to the user-specified hour and minute (StartHour:StartMinute). Exit conditions include: reverse indicator signal triggering position closure, forced closure at the end of the time window (StopHour:StopMinute), and stop-loss/take-profit triggered exits. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter governing trade share, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss share, and fixed lot. Money management also incorporates a maximum price deviation (Deviation) parameter to control slippage, plus four boolean toggles (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) for granular control over long/short entry and exit permissions.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方式（自由保证金/余额/亏损份额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing method (free margin/balance/loss ratio/fixed lot)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 允许按指标信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long positions on indicator signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 允许按指标信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on indicator signal

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（JJMA范围-100到+100，VIDIA为CMO周期，AMA为慢均线周期）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (JJMA: -100 to +100, VIDYA: CMO period, AMA: slow MA period)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 支持9种平滑算法，用户可根据品种特性灵活选择最佳平滑方式
具有完整的时间窗口控制机制，可限定交易时段避免低流动性时段
四个独立的多空开平仓开关提供精细化的交易权限控制
止损止盈参数完善，默认1:2的盈亏比设计合理
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线内重复开仓
pros_en: Supports 9 smoothing algorithms, allowing users to flexibly select the optimal smoothing method based on instrument characteristics
Complete time window control mechanism restricts trading to specified sessions, avoiding low-liquidity periods
Four independent long/short open/close toggles provide granular trade permission control
Stop-loss and take-profit parameters are comprehensive, with a default 1:2 reward-to-risk ratio
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate entries within the same bar
cons: 入场条件过于简单，仅依赖两条云线的交叉关系，缺乏多重确认机制
时间窗口控制仅精确到分钟级别，且开仓仅限单一分钟点（StartHour:StartMinute），错过即无法入场
止损1000点和止盈2000点对于M30周期而言偏大，实际风险回报可能偏离预期
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有持仓时重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤和流动性检测，在点差较大时可能产生不利成交
cons_en: Entry conditions are overly simplistic, relying solely on the crossover relationship between two cloud lines without multi-confirmation mechanisms
Time window control only precise to the minute level, and entry is restricted to a single minute point (StartHour:StartMinute), missing it means no entry
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are relatively large for M30 timeframe, actual risk-reward may deviate from expectations
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions when existing positions are already held
Lacks spread filter and liquidity detection, which may result in unfavorable fills during wide spread conditions
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，并添加最大持仓数量限制
添加点差过滤条件，当点差超过阈值时禁止开仓，保护成交质量
优化时间窗口入场逻辑，将单一分钟点改为可配置的时间段范围，提高入场灵活性
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries and implement maximum position count limits
Add spread filter condition to prohibit entry when spread exceeds a threshold, protecting fill quality
Optimize time window entry logic by changing the single minute point to a configurable time range, improving entry flexibility

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，可能同方向重复开仓导致过度敞口
止损1000点在极端行情下仍可能滑点造成更大亏损
时间窗口结束时强制平仓可能在不利价格点执行
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries causing excessive exposure
Stop-loss of 1000 points may still experience slippage in extreme market conditions resulting in larger losses
Forced closure at time window end may execute at unfavorable price points
